en: A vintage postcard featuring a monochrome wintertime photograph of a large avenue lined with stately European-style buildings. The ground is covered in snow, and trees devoid of leaves are visible along the street. The reverse side includes handwritten addresses in Swedish and a Swedish postage stamp. The text identifies the street as 'Esplanadgatan i Vinterskrud' (Esplanade Street in winter attire) and the location as Sundsvall.
